title: StockReservationRejected
description: Reply (ADR 0006). Published by inventory-service through its outbox (aggregateType=StockReservation, key=orderId). Consumed by order-service, which deduplicates by (orderId, causationId, eventType) and saga state. Nothing was held. Either the whole order was refused (orderReason) or some lines were (reason per line). Never contains stock counts (BR-CAT-04).

merchantId.description: Owner of the order's store. inventory scopes every read and write by merchantId + storeId.

orderId.description: Saga id and Kafka key; one order belongs to one store (BR-ORD-01).

causationId.description: eventId of the command this replies to; null for StockReservationExpired.

replayed.description: true when the command was a duplicate and this reply only describes the current state (BR-INV-07). It has a new eventId.

orderReason.description: ORDER_CLOSED: the order was already released or rejected. STALE_COMMAND: the command is older than the hold TTL.

reason.description: UNKNOWN_SKU also covers a SKU of another product or store (BR-CAT-04); NOT_ORDERABLE = inventory INACTIVE (BR-INV-08).
